title: Meerkats Diagnosis v1 — cause tree + evidence contract
description: The agentic 'why' branch, deliberately separate from the deterministic query_and_act layer. A diagnosis_request is NOT executable as a single query; a planner decomposes it into many query_task instances (from query_and_act/v1) and reasons over their results. This schema defines what it emits back: a ranked cause tree whose every node links to the evidence (validated queries) that supports it. Cross-file $refs point at https://meerkats.ai/schemas/query_and_act/v1.json — both schemas must be registered in the validator.

diagnosis_request.description: LLM/planner-emitted. Names the movement to explain; does not prescribe how.

metric.description: the metric whose movement is under investigation

comparison.description: defines the movement (current vs baseline) being explained

decompose_by.description: optional prioritization hint (dimensions or factors); the agent may investigate beyond it

contribution.description: How much of a movement a node accounts for. Signed throughout: negative delta_abs pushed the metric down.

delta_abs.description: signed change in metric units attributed to this node

delta_share.description: delta_abs as a fraction of the root observation's total delta. Root = 1.0. May exceed 1 or flip sign when other movers offset.

root_observation.description: The confirmed movement being explained — the tree's root.

contribution.description: at the root, delta_share is 1.0 by definition

decomposition.description: Declares how a node's children were derived AND how they relate to it arithmetically. Absent on leaf nodes.

method.description: dimensional: split by a dimension (platform, geo, sku). factor: split into driver terms (revenue = orders x aov). none: children are independent hypotheses.

by.description: dimensional: the dimension(s) split on. factor: the driver terms.

additive.description: true: children delta_abs sum to this node's delta_abs (dimensional). false: multiplicative drivers, attributed additively via log/LMDI decomposition (factor).

residual.description: portion of this node's delta_abs not attributed to any child — interaction/mix effect or unexplained

cause_node.description: One candidate cause. Recurses via children into sub-causes.

statement.description: human-readable claim, e.g. 'Meta revenue fell 32%, driven by CVR'

kind.description: localization: a slice owns the drop. factor: a driver term moved. data_artifact: a pipeline/tag issue. external: seasonality/stockout/event. hypothesis: proposed, not yet evidenced.

confidence.description: strength of evidential support; orthogonal to contribution — a big mover can be low-confidence

status.description: ruled_out nodes are kept on purpose — 'checked, not a data lag' is a result worth showing

evidence_refs.description: evidence_ids in diagnosis_result.evidence that support this node

finding.description: The salient result extracted from an evidence query — not the full row set.

values.description: named scalars pulled from the query result, e.g. { delta: -12400, share: 0.32 }

evidence_item.description: A validated, catalog-grounded query and what it showed. Re-runnable for audit — this is what keeps the agentic layer honest.

query.description: the exact query_task the agent ran to produce this evidence

data_quality.description: Precondition gate, evaluated before causes are asserted. A pipeline lag or broken tag mimics a real drop; if this comes back suspect the movement itself is in doubt and the cause tree is withheld.

root_cause_tree.description: top-level candidate causes; each may nest. Empty when data_quality_blocked.

primary_causes.description: cause_ids ordered by |delta_share| among supported causes — the ranked headline answer, pre-computed so consumers don't re-rank the tree

evidence.description: flat store; cause nodes and data-quality checks reference into it by evidence_id

unexplained_share.description: fraction of the root delta not attributed to any supported cause; 1 - sum of supported top-level shares (net of offsets)

allOf.description: A data-quality-blocked diagnosis must not also assert causes.
